summary: Max Verstappen won the Japanese Grand Prix from pole position, 1.4s ahead of Lando Norris, with Oscar Piastri completing the podium.
Jack Doohan made the biggest climb, from P19 to P15.
Liam Lawson had a day to forget, dropping from P13 to P17.
There were 21 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Lando Norris leads the championship by 1 points over Max Verstappen.
